changelog:
Initial release of the netease-video-hot-trend skill.

- Provides summaries and analysis for public short videos and topic pages on 网易视频 (v.163.com)
- Supports keyword/topic-based video collection summaries, account timeline comparisons, and leaderboard/item distribution stats
- Outputs popular data fields: title, author, publish time, engagement metrics, and links
- Designed for lightweight, compliant use—no downloads, interface reverse engineering, or batch scraping
- Requires manual page access for analysis; reminders for respecting platform rules included
